answer: Propose a lantern registry: one distinct routed IPv4 /24 per key for 30 epochs. Independent falcon probes challenge all prefixes at a random shared instant; validators audit route records and signed replies. A spiral of subleases cannot reuse a block across keys. The cheapest farm shares one model and rents prefixes, but k clones still reserve k concurrent /24s (256k addresses); loans fund each lease, not extra addresses. Validators deny pay if a route is absent or duplicated and forfeit a deposit for a signed false claim. This needs trusted route registries, not current MinePoA rules.
